title_original: 학술원 사무국에 두는 공무원의 정원 중 고위공무원단 직위의 직무등급의 표시 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for indicating the duty grades of positions deemed to be general-service civil servant positions belonging to the Senior Civil Service, among the authorized positions of national public officials in the Secretariat of the National Academy of Sciences, pursuant to the Organization of the Secretariat of the National Academy of Sciences.
